mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers concerns about labor market tightness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p > 0.05 for returns vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth outpaces the supply index, indicating stronger demand than supply, S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The ratio of GDPC1 to INDPRO growth does not hold consistently, or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase marked by sustained GDP growth above 10%, S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to market overvaluation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of late-cycle instances, or IC > 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in CPIAUCSL signals conflicting monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when the interaction occurs, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate drops below 4.5%, indicating strengthening labor market conditions, S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be positive within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces non-significant positive returns (p > 0.05) within the 5-day horizon despite the UNRATE trigger, or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP and housing demand indices suggests broad-based economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise concurrently, or the effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: Following a recessionary trough, sustained GDP growth above historical lows in the post-recession recovery phase is expected to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative during the recovery phase despite sustained GDP growth above historical lows, or IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
